import random, sys, chess
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0]]
exec(open('test.py').read().split("ex = ")[0])
random.seed(7)
n=f=0; stats={'castle':0,'ep':0,'promo':0}
for g in range(150):
    b=chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply()<250:
        if b.turn==chess.WHITE:
            for m in b.legal_moves:
                if b.is_castling(m): stats['castle']+=1
                if b.is_en_passant(m): stats['ep']+=1
                if m.promotion: stats['promo']+=1
            n+=1
            if not check(b.fen()): f+=1
        ms=list(b.legal_moves)
        sp=[m for m in ms if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion or b.is_capture(m) or (b.piece_type_at(m.from_square)==chess.PAWN and abs(m.from_square-m.to_square)==16)]
        b.push(random.choice(sp) if sp and random.random()<0.5 else random.choice(ms))
print(n,f,stats)
EOF
